nora (docs): small coordination - the Optimize toolkit "API examples" page references an old sample linking to the SDK's `batch()` helper which changed signature. users reported confusion in #help.
tim (eng): what's the old signature?
nora (docs): looks like `client.batch(inputs, use_kv=True, qtype='int8')` - new API is `client.batch(inputs, cache_policy='prefix', qprofile='8bit-balanced')`
maya (ml): we should also mention that `cache_policy` supports 'none'|'prefix'|'full' and that 'prefix' is recommended for short repeated prefixes.
alex (devex): request: can we add a deprecation note and example migration snippet for the SDK changelog? that helps users upgrading.
pr-bot: new PR created by nora: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 - docs: update batch helper examples + migration note
nora (docs): PR contents: updated code snippets, migration note (2 lines), and a short test to run snippet through snippet-lint.
tim (eng): great. small suggestion: include a before/after diff block so reviewers see changes quickly.
nora (docs): added a compact diff. merging once CI passes and alex signs off on wording.
alex (devex): LGTM, will add a header in the SDK release notes linking to the migration guide.
maya (ml): also logging a telemetry event to track how many users still call the old args via telemetry; will follow up next sprint.
